title: Better PvP Axes
description: Better PvP axes texture — simple changes that make the axe look much better in-game.
body: Better PvP axe texture — a redesigned axe texture that gives the weapon a cooler and more polished appearance while keeping the classic Minecraft style. With cleaner details and a sharper look, it makes PvP feel more enjoyable and adds extra style to every fight without changing the game's original feel
